lines.text: Your flight to London lands four and a half hours late, and twelve seconds after you file a claim, the airline bot replies: Denied, zero dollars, extraordinary weather.
Over $6.8 billion in valid passenger compensation goes unpaid every year because travelers cannot see inside the black box.
Meet SurgeWhy: an explainable multi-agent adjudicator that proves why your flight was actually delayed, rules out false excuses, and shows what flips the verdict.
In Layer 01 Data, SurgeWhy queries four independent aviation and legal sources through Zetaris using single-statement REST SQL.
On flight UA-418 from San Francisco to Heathrow, NOAA METAR weather shows ten-mile clear skies and all fourteen neighboring flights departing on time.
Tail logs on N784UA expose the real cause: a 148-minute brake sensor repair that pushed the first officer past FAA duty limits, unlocking $890 under UK261.
Built for Track 2, SurgeWhy explains not only why you won, but the exact counterfactual boundary that flips the decision.
Slide arrival delay twenty-six minutes earlier and statutory cash drops fifty percent; activate an FAA Ground Stop and delay cash flips to zero while hotel care stays mandatory.
And when Lufthansa 455 has a seven-minute cabin door sensor gap right across the three-hour legal cliff, SurgeWhy pauses at 62% confidence and requests one arrival photo instead of guessing.
In Layer 02 Build, crafted with Cursor and all four Meterless Engines, SurgeWhy uses an adversarial Airline Defense Counsel Critic.
Scout Intent routes the dispute, H-MEM recalls carrier pretext patterns, and the Counsel Critic blocks Round 1 until tail logs rule out inbound bird strikes inside the versioned World Model.
Meanwhile, the Markovian engine compresses multi-step forensic history into compact proof capsules, cutting cumulative prompt tokens by over 91%.
In Layer 03 Power, Meterless Nightshift routes fast SQL discovery to NVIDIA Nemotron 30B Lightning, and deep legal critique and counterfactual math to Nemotron 120B Super.
Every step logs a verifiable Nightshift model receipt alongside a ready-to-send passenger legal demand notice.
Three of three smoke checks and nine conformance tests pass in milliseconds. SurgeWhy: auditable proof when the black box says no.
